title: Ketheric's Shield

sources.title: Shield Blow
markers: it actually is a Strength saving throw

summary: Shield with +2 AC, Advantage on Dexterity saves and +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.

fields.Defence: +2 AC and Advantage on Dexterity saving throws. Shield proficiency applies.
fields.Arcane Enchantment: +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
fields.Shield Bash: After an enemy hits you in melee, spend a Reaction to attempt Shield Blow. The attacker must succeed on a Strength save against your spell save DC or fall Prone for 1 turn. The in-game description lists Dexterity, but the documented action uses Strength.
fields.Acquisition: Loot Ketheric Thorm in the Mind Flayer Colony. On the Moonrise rooftop, you can disarm him, wait for him to equip a nearby two-handed weapon, then pickpocket the shield while he is invulnerable.
fields.Base value: 300 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
